evidence_boundary: Existing accepted archive and fixture receipts only. New uses require independently verified source and retention grants.

BTC.historical: Native 15m retained scope; optional May 6 1m QA

PAXG.policy: Token market and spot gold are separate. Freeze venue, quote and vintage.

options.A: One approved Spot venue and trailing admitted return/liquidity ranks. Simpler same-market comparisons; thinner cross-asset coverage.
options.B: Fixed effective-dated admitted Spot roster and independently licensed context. Stronger comparability and missingness tracking; more rights and clock dependencies.
options.C: Multi-venue external cap ranking and cross-asset taxonomy. Broadest coverage; higher basis, rights and survivorship risks.

owner_decision: Choose and freeze Top 10 rank metric, eligible universe, gain/loss horizon, liquidity floor and versioned sector taxonomy before real rankings.
incremental_value: Factory/Lab freezes the same opportunity grid and costs. Compare baseline against one admitted feed at a time, with chronological splits, missing/negative cases, uncertainty and cost/latency reporting. No automatic entry authority.
